title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy mandates, information campaigns, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People update their adoption decision based on masked/unmasked behavior observed in their social network and contacts.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask requirements; non-compliant persons may be denied entry or fined under government mandate.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks from retailers subject to price, inventory, and rationing constraints.

interactions.name: information_diffusion_media
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messages that influence persons' risk perception and attitudes toward masking.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Households share norms and allocate mask supply among members, affecting individual adoption.

interactions.name: word_of_mouth
interactions.description: Persons share opinions and experiences that affect peers' attitudes and adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily proportion of the population wearing a mask.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation period.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate_last_14_days
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final 14 days of the simulation.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to mandate and campaign, e.g., difference-in-differences before and after policy.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Variance or Gini coefficient of adoption across demographic or income groups.

metrics.name: stockout_days
metrics.description: Total number of days with at least one retailer experiencing mask stockouts.

metrics.name: average_price_paid
metrics.description: Mean price paid per mask across all purchases.

metrics.name: enforcement_events_count
metrics.description: Total number of enforcement actions (denials or fines) recorded at locations.
